newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit recovery continues on fresh buying.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit recovery continues on fresh buying.

text.p: The ringgit's recovery continued in late afternoon trading on buying against Singapore dollar, dealers said on Thursday.
But further gains were expected to be limited by lack of fresh leads to trade on, the dealers said.
The ringgit recovered most of its recent losses on fresh overnight buying by funds in London and New York time.
At 1000 GMT, the ringgit was at 2.4986/91 per dollar against 2.5030/37 at close of Kuala Lumpur on Wednesday. The Singapore dollar was at 0.5639/51 per ringgit against 0.5633/39.
"Dollar/ringgit's failure to break through 2.5050 level in the last two days probably triggered the profit-taking," said a dealer with an European bank in Singapore.
She said some ringgit/Sing stop-losses after failing to go below 0.5615 per ringgit also affected dollar/ringgit.
"At 2.5050 ringgit was a good buy again. After the second quarter growth data, everything in the Malaysian economy points towards that," said a dealer with a Kuala Lumpur-based bank.
He said the volume in dollar/ringgit in London/New York was around $100 million, but in the illiquid market it was enough to move the rates by 30-40 points. - Madhav Reddy (603-230 8911)
